entities.name: Josef Buršík
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Josef Buršík was a Czech resistance fighter, general, dissident, and political prisoner. During World War II, while fighting with the First Czechoslovak Independent Field Battalion, later reorganized as the First Czechoslovak Independent Brigade he was awarded the Gold Medal of the Hero of the Soviet Union.

entities.summary: Josef Buršík was a Czech resistance fighter, general, dissident, and political prisoner. During World War II, while fighting with the First Czechoslovak Independent Field Battalion, later reorganized as the First Czechoslovak Independent Brigade he was awarded the Gold Medal of the Hero of the Soviet Union.
